strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
So this is...
What...!? What is this place...
Another dimension...
Is it something like Muge's universe!?
I see. So the Einst can create a Muge universe
too, huh?
Omoikane, analyze. ...Outside temperature, atmosphere and so on
are extremely close to Earth's.
What does that mean...?
Could this place... be Earth?
...No. This is... a galaxy. The universe itself.
The universe itself? What do you mean...?
...Didn't that Muge bastard say something like that?
"I am the universe itself... I shall lead you there."
Wasn't that it?
To a place like this?
Excellen, why does a space like this exist?
...I don't know... It's just...
Just?
This space... keeps spreading... ...so as to head toward the beginning.
Alchemie...!
Hmph, so she shows up. ...Sounds like a riddle.
...Do you feel it, Kamille?
...Yes. The way this space spreads... It's different from the universe
we know...
I'm scared, Judau... This place... it swallows people's minds...
Yeah... It sets my nerves on edge...
...A space where no human mind can remain... just spreading on forever...
Something like this...
The children they call Newtypes... seem to be reacting strongly, but
with the Einst before us, we can't afford to dawdle!
All units, launch! We don't know what might happen!
Be careful!
Excellen, can you sortie?
...Okay.
Here, we'll learn everything... including what our fight is about.
You're alone!?
That girl... She's not like before... And this place... It's so eerie.
But?
Somehow... it's almost soothing... I wonder why. It doesn't feel
all that bad.
...The universe overflows with human thoughts... with hearts...
But here, there's nothing...
The universe is saturated... That is why all manner of chaos is born,
and that chaos expands the universe further...
Whoa, whoa... You okay!? You're not making any sense!
That Einst girl included... something's off compared to usual.
But we can't back down...!
...It just means we're that close to the heart of it all.
...All that's left is to see... what happens next.
Brother... What's that!?
...Saucer Beasts of the Vega Star Federation...
Even Empress Janera's... Saint Magma is here!
What the heck's goin' on!?
Akira... What are those?
Yeah, Kyoretsu Beasts...
...What's going on...? Didn't we beat them all...?
Never mind whether we beat them... The real question is why
so much firepower is gathered in this other dimension.
Quite so. Banjo, I have run an analysis...
They are no illusions, yet I did find something a bit odd.
I am sending it to the Nadesico. ...Hoshino, what do you make of it?
Yes. The data on every enemy we've fought,
from the Nadesico to the Gandor, the Ra Cailum, the Gran Garan...
all the way up to the current Elshank, is stored and saved.
Is there... a problem with that data?
Even so, their ID codes come up as unknown.
You mean... it recognizes them as enemies we've never fought!?
Why!?
Same shape... but different inside?
I created them...
Created... all of them!?
Just like she made a Gespenst out of my Weissritter...
What the heck? So they're just fakes!
The Gil Gear... So Gil isn't actually
piloting that one.
Geez, don't scare me like that.
This is no time to relax. Considering that machine's specs...
...Even fakes could be stronger than the real thing, couldn't they!?
Like the Gespenst...
Only on the surface. But... their essence... that I cannot do...
(I knew it... Is she wavering...?)
But the Einst series that matter... only hers are here...?
Seems they think these things are enough
to deal with us. They're underestimating us.
Or perhaps... they're buying time.
That's possible.
Whatever they're scheming... We'll just have to clear these out
and make the boss show himself.
Right. We're not gonna lose!
All right! Let's trash these guys fast and say goodbye to this place!
Here we go...! O heaven, O earth, O fire, O water...
grant us your power...!
All beings born of heaven, born of earth... Even so... we...
So you finally show up... Einst Regisseur, wasn't it!?
A-And there's two of them! Show!
I can see that! Be quiet!
The problem isn't that there are two... It's that a second one appeared.
Huh? What do you mean, Brother!?
We thought... that thing was the enemy's leader.
But it has appeared several times before.
Yeah... And we smashed it every time.
There was one inside the Bandock too, y'know?
The one that led its comrades here has now appeared in numbers.
...Which means...
That thing... is now the one being led...
...Meaning there's something above it... or something has appeared...!
Then that thing is...
Our final opponent...!
...That's it, isn't it, Alchemie?
...We were searching for... a new... form of life... and it...
Is complete... you mean?
...Then the revived enemy mecha were likely experiments to that end.
...No, that is...
Tch, then let's wipe these guys out quick and get a look at
this "new life" of theirs!
Guess we've got no choice.
Ugh... Something new... to replace... But that attempt...
...It begins... a new... heartbeat... The will of the universe...
Kyosuke... It's coming...!
That which... will become... the will of the universe...
Enough already! Talk so the rest of us can understand!
A new... will!?
If this is some sort of universe of the beginning...
then there's one more thing it needs.
Life... is it...!
Show...!
What is it, Cham?
What's about to happen?
...The Star of La Mu...
Raideen is resonating like never before!!
Here it comes!!
...Welcome... you who have come... from the land of the beginning.
It talked...! That's a first, other than that girl...!?
Evolution... or should I say adaptation?
Unrealistic as it is...
I'm used to it by now. ...This thing...
Now... a new... evolution... begins...
A new... evolution!?
What's it talking about?
That Muge bastard said the same kinda thing...!
Him, the ultimate in human evolution!? Dream on!
Muge... Zorbados... and... the Dirad... In a sense...
they were complete...
The Dirad... Those guys from the plant planet!?
Are you saying we Earthlings... are imperfect!?
...Born of... the land of the beginning... the seeds of life... The seeds
themselves were flawed...
...The seeds of life... came from... Earth...
I see... Now I get it... All life... was born from the land of the beginning,
from Earth...!
Even us...?
I see... Life is life... Those with machine bodies like us, those with
bodies of plants...
Then the people of Lilith too... and Roll's planet, Latesia...?
When Muge Zorbados claimed to be the ultimate in human evolution...
he wasn't wrong. Power to create a universe, vast power to destroy...
and the power to control even souls...
So that's it. Psychic powers, Aura Power, psychokinesis...
In many directions, in many forms... we've evolved.
And the base of it all... is Earthlings...
Then... I'm... originally the same as Show!?
...That kinda makes me happy.
Cham...
Aura Power too... and opening the Aura Road...
Shema, 60,000 light-years from Earth... An unrelated blue planet...
Is that why its legend was handed down on planet Radorio...?
The ninja legend...! So us piloting Kurojishi and the royal machines
is evolution too!?
So I'm... evolved, huh? Tch.
Newtype awakening... that too was humanity leaving its cradle, Earth,
going into space, and evolving as it was destined
to... So that is what human innovation means...
But... it said there was a flaw...
Evolution... So the result of that... is what produced
someone like Haman...!?
Scirocco too...
So Lalah... was its victim...
The Gyandlar too... With their overblown ambitions,
they're scum who won't hesitate to hurt others.
But... we were born from the same place too, weren't we!?
Spirit... the evolution of the heart... is unrelated to the flesh...
However...
However...?
The universe... is beginning to close in on itself... Because the seeds of life...
and evolution... have spread far too chaotically...
Heh... You're a laugh.
Banjo...?
By your logic... I'd be... something that doesn't... evolve...
Huh? What did you say, Banjo!?
...Nothing at all. ...Maybe there was only one beginning,
true... But evolution goes in many directions.
If your role is to watch over that... then you've overstepped this time.
If it is the Cronos clan's fate to wander the universe and fight on...
then so be it. If we fall here, then go ahead and
put an end to what you call mistaken evolution.
Brother...!
But... in this battle,
we fight for the universe we ourselves have built...!
...Fools... who can only destroy... their own universe...
Because it got out of hand... you'll reset everything...
That's your aim. And this space... meant to paint over the old universe...
is a new universe, is that it...!
...Kyosuke...
And Alchemie there too... born of that shortsighted thinking...
is its victim.
What do you mean!? That Einst girl is...
...Yes... the one... who was not chosen...
Not chosen? Kyosuke... then... am I...
This is... a new universe... no, a far, far vaster universe...
the foundation of the galaxy...
In this empty universe? ...One that merely gets rid of
whatever is inconvenient...!
I... have come to want to see it too.
Huh!? You...
Alchemie, what are you up to...?
...I care about Kyosuke... But I don't know if this feeling is truly
my own...
She... for Kyosuke...?
Will this feeling... be painted over too...?
Who knows? ...To find out for yourself... you
decided to fight, didn't you?
...That's your own heart. ...Not mine.
.........Excellen...
...Basing it on those of the land of the beginning... was a mistake.
In the end...
Silence. ...This galaxy, built by everyone
who lives in this universe... Whatever becomes of it in the end,
we're the ones who decide its fate...!
1. Destroy Stern Neu Regisseur.
1. All allies destroyed
Why... could I not... become... a perfect... new... life...
...You... weren't chosen either...
......?? I... do not... understand...
...I get it now. You were only meant to watch over Earth... the universe
evolving from the land of the beginning... That was your only role.
And... defeating it... guiding those who could defeat it...
that was our role...
